title: What Hydrogen 2.0 Pipelines Is
definition: Hydrogen 2.0 Pipelines: repurposed gas grids carrying clean hydrogen.
description:
Hydrogen 2.0 Pipelines is repurposed gas grids carrying clean hydrogen. It sits squarely in Future Energy Systems, the frontier where H2 compressors science becomes pipe logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are leak detection-scale. Societies that master pipe hulls early will shape embrittlement fixes practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. title: Real Research Today: Hydrogen 2.0 Pipelines
definition: Today's documented research behind Hydrogen 2.0 Pipelines.
description:
The road to Hydrogen 2.0 Pipelines is already being paved. Green hydrogen electrolyzer capacity is scaling under EU and US clean-hydrogen programs. ITER in France is the world's largest fusion experiment, targeting first plasma and Q>10 operation.

Enhanced geothermal (Fervo Energy, Eavor) drills deep closed-loop wells for baseload clean power. Together these programs form the H2 compressors foundation that Hydrogen 2.0 Pipelines will build on — the pipe logistics results, the embrittlement fixes methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as pipe logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Hydrogen 2.0 Pipelines Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Hydrogen 2.0 Pipelines: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Hydrogen 2.0 Pipelines — repurposed gas grids carrying clean hydrogen.

Phase 1 — Prove (H2 compressors): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (pipe logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (embrittlement fixes): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (leak detection): pipe hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and gas grids-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
